# Keep documentation warning policy separate from the Sphinx process result

943 adds policy checks after a successful Sphinx process: configured fatal warning patterns, allowed error patterns and an optional warning-count bound. It rejects --no-autodoc with --check-num-warnings because the count would describe a different document set. The accepted policy still sets a bound of 20 and asks contributors not to add new allowed errors unless they are existing known issues. Preserve these separate checks instead of treating process success as the full quality gate.

Scope: Source documentation validation policy.
